metric: season rainfall as a fraction of the crop's requirement
param_unit: ky: loss = ky x (1 - rainfall / requirement), between 0 and 100 %
note: Central and low: FAO seasonal ky for maize. High: 2.5 = 1 / (1 - 0.6), yield falling in a straight line to zero at 60 % of the requirement (drought_zero_yield_at). Applied to all crops until crop rows are accepted (decision 0002).

metric: degree days above the crop's heat_moderate_c, summed over its heat window
param_unit: per degree day, log-yield coefficient: loss = 1 - exp(-k x degree days)
note: Lobell et al. 2011: -0.01 under optimal rain-fed management, -0.017 under drought (high). Applied to all crops at each crop's own threshold until crop rows are accepted (decision 0002).
